about.heroSubtitle: Mobile-first, offline-ready, free. Share lists with your family and check items as you shop.

features.desc: Every change shows up on every device right away.
What you do without a connection syncs as soon as you are back online.
Lists in common with family or housemates.
Suggestions based on what you buy most often.
Your shopping habits, laid out plainly.
Connects to Claude and other assistants over MCP.
No ads, no tracking, no analytics.

faq.q: What does Buy The Way do?
faq.a: A real-time shared shopping list app. Add items, check them off, sync instantly with anyone you share a list with.
Yes. Lists and items are cached locally; any change you make offline syncs as soon as you reconnect.
Yes. From list settings, add a collaborator by their Google email. They see updates in real time.
Lists are stored in Google Firestore with strict per-user access rules. Only you and your collaborators can read or write your lists.
Free. No paid tier, no ads, no analytics.
It is a PWA - install it from your browser to your home screen and it behaves like a native app.

faq.q: Can I use Buy The Way with an AI assistant?
faq.a: Yes, in beta. In your assistant (Claude or another MCP-compatible one) add the connector https://buytheway.app/mcp, sign in and approve: it can read and update your lists, but not delete them or manage collaborators. Disconnect it any time from Settings → Connected apps.
Yes. From Settings → Delete account: wipes your lists, profile, catalog and revokes sign-in access in one operation.
Google sign-in or an email sign-in link.
Data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest on Google infrastructure. End-to-end encryption is not used so collaborators can read items.
Italian and English. The interface switches based on your preference in Settings.
